Game Overview

In Lost Puppy Rescue and Care, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a heartwarming journey to rescue a lost puppy in the rain. Gently nurture, clean, and play with your new furry friend, building trust and transforming his world. This serene adventure focuses on kindness and connection, offering heartwarming moments and playful interactions.
